messages:
maria: quick ping — opened PR that cleans up a couple of naming/format nits: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/2345
kevin: saw it, thanks. lint is failing on snake_case -> camelCase rename.
rita: small rename looks fine to me, but can we keep the db column as request_id? don't want migration now.
alex: I can push a tiny follow-up to leave db column and map in code, will open a patch.
ci-bot: build/test: failed — lint (1 error). See logs: https://ci.internal/build/7821 :x:
kevin: if alex takes the mapping approach, that avoids migration and keeps API names nicer.
maria: mapping sounds good. Alex, if you can add mapping and run `make fmt` that's perfect.
alex: will do. local steps:
```bash
git checkout -b fix/pr-2345-mapping
make fmt
# update model field mapping in service/handlers/request.go
``` 
alex: pushing in ~10m
sam: FYI we have a small merge window at 16:00 UTC, if this is in before that we can ship with other tiny fixes. otherwise hold for tomorrow.
maria: ok let's aim for the window, alex lmk when pushed and i'll re-run CI.
ci-bot: status update — running lint for branch fix/pr-2345-mapping :hourglass_flowing_sand:
kevin: quick nit: in request.go can we rename `reqID` -> `requestID` for clarity? tiny change, no functional effect.
alex: can do, will include in the push.
rita: LGTM pending tests. if CI is clean, +1 from me. :thumbsup:
sam: +1 — thanks for handling the migration concern.
ci-bot: build/test: success — all checks passed :white_check_mark:
maria: merging now. thanks everyone for quick turnaround.
kevin: thanks! :tada:
